title: Total Distance to the Equal Elements

concept.title: Group the positions of each value, use prefix sums inside a group
body: For every position `i` you want the sum of `|i - j|` over **all other positions `j` with the same value**. Comparing every pair costs `n^2`. First **group the positions** by value with a hash map (a value maps to the sorted list of its positions). Inside one group with positions `p[0] < p[1] < ... < p[m-1]`, the position `p[t]` has `t` positions on its left and `m - 1 - t` on its right.

body.code:
left_sum  = p[0] + ... + p[t-1]
right_sum = p[t+1] + ... + p[m-1]
result = p[t] * t - left_sum + right_sum - p[t] * (m - 1 - t)

body: The distances to the left are `p[t] - p[s]` (sum: `p[t] * t - left_sum`) and to the right `p[s] - p[t]` (sum: `right_sum - p[t] * (m - 1 - t)`). Keeping a running `left_sum` while walking along the group, and `right_sum = total - left_sum - p[t]`, gives each result in O(1).

statement: Given an array of `n` integers, print for every position `i` (counting from 0) the sum of `|i - j|` over all positions `j != i` with `a[j] = a[i]`. A position with no equal partner gets 0.

examples.note: The 1s are at positions 0, 2, 3: the results are 5, 3 and 4. The 3s at 1 and 5 give 4 each; the 2 gives 0.

hints: Group the positions of equal values with a map.
Inside a group, split the other positions into those on the left and on the right.
Use a running sum of the left positions and the group total to get the sums in O(1).

explanation: Positions are grouped by value. Inside a group, the sums of the distances to the left and right positions come from a running prefix sum and the group total.
solution.complexity: Time O(n) on average, space O(n).

code.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

groups = {}
for i, x in enumerate(a):
    groups.setdefault(x, []).append(i)
res = [0] * n
for pos in groups.values():
    total = sum(pos)
    left = 0
    m = len(pos)
    for t, p in enumerate(pos):
        right = total - left - p
        res[p] = p * t - left + right - p * (m - 1 - t)
        left += p
print(*res)
